seo.description: openIndu-studio chains electrical modules, circuit diagrams, BOM, I/O addressing, PLC programming, and HMI programming into a traceable AI Agent workflow.
seo.keywords: openIndu-studio,PLC workflow,electrical design,BOM,I/O address table,PLC programming,HMI programming,AI Agent

hero.title: openIndu-studio Overview
hero.subtitle: openIndu-studio breaks industrial-automation projects down -- from requirements to PLC/HMI programming -- into a collaborative, traceable standard process (the six-step PLC development workflow), progressively integrating Claude Code and MCP knowledge retrieval.

electrical.title: Electrical Module Breakdown
electrical.description: Split electrical modules based on the equipment list and process requirements, defining each module's functional boundaries, actuators, and sensor needs.

circuit.title: Circuit Diagram Design
circuit.description: Generate circuit-diagram design recommendations around power, control, drive, safety, and communication circuits, and output preliminary I/O requirements.

bom.title: BOM List
bom.description: Compile a bill of materials -- PLCs, HMIs, drives, low-voltage electrical components, cable terminals -- based on the circuit diagram and brand-selection rules.

io.title: I/O Address Planning
io.description: Generate an I/O address table from equipment actions, signal types, and brand addressing conventions, providing the basis for PLC variable definitions.

plc.title: PLC Programming
plc.description: Design the program structure from the I/O table and process flow, generating draft core logic for sequencing, alarms, manual/auto modes, and communication.

hmi.title: HMI Programming
hmi.description: Design HMI screens and variable-binding schemes around equipment operation, status monitoring, alarm diagnostics, and parameter maintenance.

artifactChain.heading: End-to-End Deliverable Chain
artifactChain.description: Workflow output converges into a structured IR, which the converters engine then renders into real engineering files -- covering BOM, I/O tables, circuit diagrams, PLC/HMI middleware, and project reports.

roadmap.heading: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Phase P2 will integrate brand-manual RAG retrieval, agent orchestration, file-template generation, and project-level workflow logging -- enabling end-to-end assisted development from design input to code drafts.
